versions.description_html:
Discover how the Microsoft Purview Unified Catalog simplifies data discovery, governance, and quality across your organization in plain English.

Your company's data isn't missing, it's just impossible to find. Most teams keep their data spread across different systems, and when someone needs the right numbers, they end up asking around instead of searching.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • The Data Problem
  • What It Actually Is
  • Domains
  • Data Products
  • Glossary Terms
  • Data Quality
  • Who Uses It
  • Recap and One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
